 Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Torrential rain causes widespread flooding in South Florida
 Entire neighbourhoods remain flooded across Southern Florida after heavy overnight rainfall on Tuesday night. More than a foot of rain hit some parts of the region, according to the National Weather Service.
 Disruptions have impacted schools, roads, hospitals and airports. In Hollywood, Florida, a synagogue roof collapsed due to the rain.
 Additional rainfall is expected through the week.
